title: Standing delegation for routine releases (GREEN / AMBER / RED)
notes: Changing this file changes its SHA-256, which ends the delegation until Livio sets the new hash in the repository variable RELEASE_POLICY_SHA256 and records a new activation row in docs/livio-asks.md (changing authority is RED). A release is judged by the policy on the LIVE commit, never by the one in the change.
Order of classification: a RED pattern wins over everything; then AMBER; then GREEN; a path that matches nothing is RED (fail closed).

releaseEvidence.evidenceFromGitHub: CI success (check run 'checks') and the nightly backup run time are read from the GitHub API at release time; the register's own CI/backup fields are not trusted. The review is an attestation: recorded, not provable.
releaseEvidence.ciSource: the 'test' job of deploy.yml runs ci.yml on the exact commit and the deploy job needs it

pauseSwitch.rule: Anything other than exactly ACTIVE (unset, empty, PAUSED, active) pauses automatic release. The pin variable must equal the SHA-256 of this file on the live commit.
